name: Harwick Ossel
excerpt: Harwick Ossel is the deputy of Chief Surveyor Vane.
notes:
- Harwick Ossel is the deputy of Chief Surveyor Vane.
- He has taken over operational responsibilities from Vane.
- He has the authority to grant explicit authorization for third-party access to the Division's archive.

- Harwick Ossel is a Senior Surveyor of the Admiralty.
- He serves as the deputy head of the Cartographic Division.
- He is fifty-three years old.
- He is heavyset with a deliberate manner.
- He has thirty years of service in the navigational corps.
- He is known for organizational skills rather than navigation aptitude.
- He knows where things are filed and who controls access.
- Rella Corse filed a complaint against him for supplying altered survey data.
- The investigation found no corroborating evidence against him.
- He was promoted eight months after Corse's dismissal.
- He lives in the upper district of Tiveck in rented accommodation.
- His accommodation is nicer than a deputy surveyor's salary would support.
- He is a member of two Admiralty social committees.
- He is regarded as a capable administrator.
- He has no publicly known enemies.
- There is a rumor of a private arrangement with the Deepwater Guild.
- Such an arrangement would breach the Compact of Survey Rights.

- Rella Corse filed a formal complaint against Harwick Ossel, alleging he falsified survey coordinates to benefit his private interests.
- The complaint was investigated and closed without findings, after which Ossel was promoted.
